notes: §1985:IX.4.6.3 SR1 (both amendments): 'If identifier-1 is a function-identifier, it must reference an alphanumeric function. Record-name-1 and identifier-1 must not reference the same storage area.' MoveBinder.BindFromPhrase applies the FromPhraseRules.Rewrite row: the function screen (COBOL1914; its set adds boolean and national, which no 85 function has: NATIONAL-OF is COBOL1502 at 85) and CheckPhraseOperandIsNotRecordArea over StorageSharing.IsRecordAreaOf (below 2023, COBOL6827). Probes at 85, indexed random/sequential/dynamic: refused FROM FUNCTION RANDOM, INTEGER (NUM), LENGTH (WREC), FROM IREC2, a full-length subordinate, a SAME RECORD AREA peer, and REWRITE IREC2 FROM WHOLE; FROM literal is COBOL0871 (c); accepted CURRENT-DATE, UPPER-CASE (WREC), a WS item and a part (IKEY), each status 49 after the failed OPEN I-O. COBOL1914 quotes §2023:14.9.35.3 SR9 at 85 (PB4950). The gap: as for READ INTO, a reference-modified operand is never the record area, so FROM IREC (1:10) and FROM WHOLE (1:10) compile. kb/Work PB5412 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-read3/rd-08.json). || RE-VERDICTED CONFORMS (kb/Work PB5412, wave 20262025 group B): StorageSharing.IsRecordAreaOf decides 'the same storage area' on the storage the operand denotes (StorageExtent.OfReference), not on its form, so a literal reference modification of the whole record (R (1:10); R (1:) whatever R's length), the element of a table of one occurrence and a 66 THROUGH alias of the whole record are refused COBOL6827, and a SAME AREA peer's record is the area too (1985:VII.2.13.4 GR1, FileModel.StorageSharingFiles); docs/FILES_DESIGN.md D31(b) is revised. The read-3 and read-4 probes are all refused now. The function sentence's COBOL1914 message now cites the 1985 rule of the file's module (kb/Work PB5486: FromPhraseRules.FunctionRuleCite is an EditionCite).

next.reason: Amendment X3.23a-1989 added the function sentence and X3.23b-1993 made the storage sentence unconditional again: 'If identifier-1 is a function-identifier, it must reference an alphanumeric function. Record-name-1 and identifier-1 must not reference the same storage area' (§1985:IX.4.6.3 SR1). Both halves differ in 2023. (1) §2023:14.9.35.3 SR9: 'If identifier-1 references a function and the FILE phrase is not specified, identifier-1 shall reference an alphanumeric, boolean, or national function'; words that differ: 'alphanumeric function' against 'alphanumeric, boolean, or national function', a widened range. (2) 2023 has no syntax rule refusing shared storage. The implicit MOVE of §2023:14.9.35.4 GR7 governs instead; its NOTE 2 says the overlapping-operand rules 'apply to any cases in which the storage area identified by identifier-1 and the record area associated with file-name-1 share any part of their storage areas' and 'The result of execution of the REWRITE statement is undefined if the result of execution of the implicit MOVE statement described in General rule 7a is undefined'. Those rules give 'the result of the statement is undefined' for items not described by the same entry (§2023:14.6.10 GR1) and 'the same as if the data items shared no part of their respective storage areas' for the same entry (§2023:14.6.10 GR2); §2023:14.9.35.4 GR10 allows for the case ('provided that identifier-1 is not one or part of one of the record descriptions subordinate to the file-description'). A compile-time refusal became an accepted program whose result is defined or undefined; no exception condition.
